rows.label: bf02180150_0010
rows.name:
Thanks, you saved us.
But why did you...?

rows.label: bf02180150_0050
rows.name:
Truth is, those soldiers
are always throwing their weight around,

rows.label: bf02180150_0060
rows.name:
so I was going to give them a taste
of the new Rocket Kamukamu, mo.

rows.label: bf02180150_0070
rows.name:
Then you and the others came running by, Nii-chan,
with those soldiers chasing you, mo.

rows.label: bf02180150_0080
rows.name:
It missed and hit a water pipe,
but it worked out fine, mo.

rows.label: bf02180150_0090
rows.name: I see. So that was you earlier...

rows.label: bf02180150_0110
rows.name:
So your name's Tora. I'm Rex,
and this is Homura.

rows.label: bf02180150_0130
rows.name: Nice to meet you, mo. Mofufu...

rows.label: bf02180150_0150
rows.name:
Actually, there's one more reason
I saved you, mo.

rows.label: bf02180150_0170
rows.name:
Well, we can talk about that once
we get to Tora's house, mo.
